meta.rule: Only sentences the venue's own sheet prints. A value the sheet does not state stays absent here, and stays blank and flagged on the site.
notes: The room page states the dailies run twice a day outside event windows and that the fields total $200,000 in weekly guarantees.
Daily sheets carry their own suspension clause; the WPT World Championship runs Nov 27 - Dec 21, 2026 in the same room, so a daily row is not dependable inside that window.
